title: Hay Camp Brewing Co.
venue_description:
About the Venue

Hay Camp Brewing Company is Rapid City's first production brewery founded in 2013 carrying the historical name given to the city in 1876. The venue operates as both a craft brewery and premier live music space featuring authentic Black Hills heritage with repurposed woodwork from the historic Homestake Mine throughout the building. Located in downtown Rapid City the brewery crafts small-batch handcrafted ales exclusively for on-site sales with a rotating selection of beer styles from light crisp lagers to barrel-aged imperial stouts.

Venue Spaces

The facility features three distinct areas serving different purposes. The Tavern serves as the main gathering space where guests enjoy craft beers in a warm welcoming atmosphere. The Commons houses the Bashful Bison an on-site deli and eatery serving locally sourced food daily starting at 10:30 AM. The Event Space accommodates up to 250 people for concerts weddings and celebrations making it one of downtown's most versatile venues.

Music & Entertainment

Hay Camp hosts a diverse calendar of music events including the monthly Jazz Jam on First Tuesdays (6-9 PM) presented by Improvise Arts. The venue features regional and national touring musicians several times per month with live music typically scheduled Thursday through Saturday nights. Summer brings special loading dock concerts. Weekly recurring events include Trivia Thursdays (6-8 PM) Karaoke Wednesdays (6-9 PM) and Free Pinball Fridays (4-6 PM). The jazz jam welcomes musicians of all skill levels with a house band setting the mood before opening to an inclusive jam session.

Food & Beverage

The on-site Bashful Bison provides locally sourced food options that pair perfectly with the brewery's handcrafted ales. Hours are Monday-Wednesday 11 AM-9 PM Thursday-Friday 11 AM-10 PM and Saturday 9 AM-10 PM. The venue offers an impressive beer selection brewed on-site including IPAs sours pilsners stouts lagers and seasonal experimental brews. Guest can also enjoy near-beer style seltzers with rotating fruit flavors.

title: Main Street Square
venue_description:
The Square

Main Street Square stands as downtown Rapid City's premier public gathering space located in the heart of the city. Managed by a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization this vibrant outdoor venue does not receive city funding but operates through donations from Partners in Progress event proceeds and grants. The square serves as a fun-filled destination featuring special events arts and culture live concerts seasonal ice skating and interactive fountains throughout the year.

Location & Surroundings

Situated among the City of Presidents statues boutiques eateries and galleries Main Street Square offers a central location for community gatherings and cultural events. The square provides modern sound systems and stage lighting for performances with beautiful open-air spaces perfect for concerts and festivals. Parking is available in the nearby main parking ramp with over 500 spots plus metered street parking throughout downtown during weekday and Saturday hours.

Music Events

The square hosts the Emerging Performing Artists Open Mic series on First Fridays as part of the downtown Art Walk events coordinated with the Rapid City Arts Council. These free open mic nights run from 6-8 PM welcoming local musicians poets and performing artists to showcase their talents. The square also presents free concerts throughout the year including summer concert series and special events. Street performers buskers and musicians wishing to perform must contact Main Street Square office for signed agreements and permissions.

Community Programming

Beyond music Main Street Square serves as a family-friendly destination with activities for all ages. The interactive fountains provide summer entertainment while seasonal ice skating draws winter crowds. The square regularly hosts art walks poetry readings painting activities and cultural celebrations. First Friday events often feature live music from 5-6 PM followed by open mic sessions creating a vibrant atmosphere for downtown visitors and residents alike.

title: Aby's Rapid City
venue_description:
Historic Venue

Aby's Rapid City occupies a historic family-owned grain mill dating back to the early 1900s now transformed into a contemporary indoor and outdoor music venue and bar. The building has been beautifully renovated maintaining its historic architecture while creating an inviting modern space for music art and community gathering. Located at 406 5th Street in downtown Rapid City beside Woodland Republic Beer the venue has become the city's premier destination for live music craft beer and wine.

The Space

The venue features both indoor and outdoor areas with a carefully designed layout that showcases art throughout the building. The converted grain mill offers unique industrial charm with modern amenities including 12 beer taps featuring local craft breweries a curated wine selection and now a full liquor bar. The space includes a stage area for performances bar seating and tables creating an intimate atmosphere for music lovers. Recent renovations have added a kitchen and expanded beverage options. Parking is limited with visitors encouraged to use the nearby downtown parking garage.

Music & Events

Aby's has established itself as a central hub for entertainment in downtown Rapid City operating Wednesday through Saturday evenings (5 PM-midnight on Wed-Thu 5 PM-2 AM on Fri-Sat). The venue hosts open mic nights on Wednesdays providing PA system for performers. Live music fills the space Thursday through Saturday with performances ranging from local bands to regional touring acts. The venue regularly features DJ sets poetry nights and special concerts. Sunday brunches include the weekly Jazz Brunch series with local jazz artists performing from 11:15 AM-2 PM alongside bottomless mimosas and elevated breakfast menu.

Community Connection

In 2025 Aby's partnered with Elevate Rapid City and the Downtown Innovation District positioning the venue as a key player in the city's cultural development. The venue hosts diverse events including trivia nights bingo karaoke and occasional boxing robot competitions. Open mic and poetry nights draw performers of all skill levels creating a supportive environment for artistic expression. The friendly staff and welcoming atmosphere have made Aby's a favorite gathering place for locals and visitors seeking live entertainment in a unique historic setting.

title: Dahl Arts Center
venue_description:
Cultural Hub

The Dahl Arts Center has served as western South Dakota's premier arts center since October 1974 when it was gifted to Rapid City by Arndt and Agnes Dahl following the devastating 1972 Rapid City flood. Managed by the Rapid City Arts Council on behalf of the city this municipal facility stands as a beacon of hope and cultural enrichment in the community. The center houses five professional visual arts galleries an interactive children's gallery the historic Cyclorama Mural of American History a gift shop classrooms and a flexible event space.

Performing Arts Programming

The Dahl Arts Center hosts the Emerging Performing Artists series featuring local musicians open mic opportunities and performing artists. These events take place both at the Dahl and at Main Street Square as part of the First Friday Art Walk series. The open mic nights provide a platform for emerging talent in the community with performers signing up to showcase original works covers poetry and various performance art. The center provides PA system and stage support for these events creating an inclusive environment for artists of all skill levels and backgrounds.

Community Arts

Beyond performing arts the Dahl offers extensive visual arts programming art education for youth and adults open pottery studios open art studios and teen art studios. The center serves as a multi-purpose community space used by artists and arts organizations for exhibitions classes private events and corporate gatherings. Gallery admission is free with some ticketed classes and events. The Dahl Artists Market features goods from over 50 regional artisans. Open Monday through Saturday 10 AM-5 PM the center welcomes all community members to explore creativity participate in programs and attend cultural events.

Mission & Support

The Rapid City Arts Council incorporated as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in 1968 manages the Dahl with a mission to champion inclusive innovative and inspiring arts opportunities to enrich the communities served. Support comes from volunteers donors members the South Dakota Community Foundation Black Hills Area Community Foundation and the South Dakota Arts Council with funds from the State of South Dakota through the Department of Tourism and the National Endowment for the Arts.

title: Firehouse Brewing Company
venue_description:
Historic Brewery & Restaurant

Firehouse Brewing Company stands as South Dakota's oldest operating brewery housed in the original Rapid City firehouse built in 1915. Listed on the National Historic Register this four-layer brick building exemplifies the Chicago School style and features authentic firefighting memorabilia from Rapid City's early fire brigades including the original brass fire pole ladders patches and more. The brewery opened December 5 1991 just 93 days after renovation began transforming the historic fire station into a brewpub that maintains its original glory with polished brass and firefighting equipment adorning the walls bar and ceiling.

Dining & Brewing

The restaurant operates daily offering a diverse menu of Midwestern specialties including locally sourced buffalo burgers Rancher's Pie barbecue with house-made sauces and more. Families appreciate the kid's menu root beer and free firehats. The brewery crafts approximately 40 different unique beers annually with nine beers on tap at any given time using 350-620 pounds of grain and 4-19 pounds of hops per batch. Popular ingredients include honey spruce tips orange zest cacao mint and ginger. Hours are Monday-Wednesday 11 AM-9 PM Thursday 11 AM-10 PM Friday 11 AM-9 PM Saturday 11 AM-9 PM and Sunday 11 AM-8:30 PM.

Live Music Venue

After a two-year hiatus Firehouse brought back its longstanding tradition of live music on the outdoor patio in 2024. The heated outdoor patio features beautiful views of downtown Rapid City fire pits and a band shell for performances. Live music occurs every Friday and Saturday night from 8:30-10:30 PM during warmer months featuring talented regional artists performing various genres including blues jazz folk and rock. Artists include Sophia Beatty BW Swing Band the Nervous Turtles and Lonely Rangers among others. The venue's outdoor space creates nostalgic music nights where memories have been made throughout the decades.

Additional Venues

Adjacent to the brewery is Firehouse Wine Cellars where music enthusiasts can start their evening enjoying award-winning wines or craft beer before heading to the brewery for outdoor music. The company has also established satellite restaurants and taprooms across the Black Hills extending their reach beyond the original downtown Rapid City location. The combination of historic ambiance craft beer quality food and live entertainment makes Firehouse a family-friendly destination and cultural landmark in Rapid City.

title: Murphy's Pub & Grill
venue_description:
Historic Downtown Pub

Murphy's Pub & Grill has been a downtown Rapid City fixture since the repeal of Prohibition in 1933 originally starting as a small establishment with just 14 stools six booths and a bar. After a fire in 1984 the venue underwent renovation and expansion establishing itself as both a full-service restaurant and vibrant pub. Located inside the historic Rapid City Garage building the gastropub combines the welcoming attributes of a local pub with the passion creativity and selection of a modern restaurant creating a comfortable hometown feel.

Food & Beverage

The menu features upscale pub fare with signature dishes including the famous Buffalo Meatloaf (stuffed with mushrooms wrapped in bacon served with mashed potatoes and asparagus) and Fancy Fried Pickles (fried pickle spears wrapped in prosciutto stuffed with mozzarella). The kitchen is almost entirely scratch-made offering sandwiches burgers salads and chef's specials. The bar boasts 26 beers on tap with approximately 70% from local South Dakota breweries including Lost Cabin Beer Co. Spearfish Brewing Company and Dakota Point Brewing plus 40 more bottles. Wine selections include Prairie Berry Winery's signature Red Ass Rhubarb. Cocktails are inspired by top lists nationwide. Happy hour runs Monday-Friday 3-6 PM.

Live Music Programming

Murphy's hosts local live music on the outdoor patio every Thursday Friday and Saturday night. Following the 2025 cancellation of the Summer Nights concert series Murphy's debuted a new summer patio series featuring live music Thursdays from 6-8 PM in addition to existing Friday and Saturday performances. The spacious patio offers a pet-friendly environment with fire pits creating an ideal setting for enjoying music and dining outdoors. The venue also features a secret speakeasy underneath the restaurant operating on word-of-mouth with limited advertising maintaining the authentic speakeasy tradition.

Venue Details

Hours are Monday-Thursday 11 AM-midnight Friday-Saturday 11 AM-2 AM and Sunday 11 AM-9 PM with lunch served Monday-Saturday 11 AM-4:30 PM. The venue offers two private event spaces for functions ranging from 60 to 130 guests. An event calendar is maintained on the website. Murphy's accepts reservations which are recommended during peak hours especially Friday and Saturday. The downtown location provides easy access with metered street parking and the main downtown parking ramp nearby.
